en: Color-printed historical postcard showing the inner courtyard of a large Renaissance castle complex. The scene includes ornate stone façades, stairways, arched windows, and a tall tower with a spire in the background. In the foreground there is a fountain with a statue resembling Neptune holding a trident. The sky is blue with light clouds. Printed German text appears at the top of the card.
